featured_reviews.name: Naveen Mendan
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re looking for a chill spot to unwind in Dahisar, Kafe 9 is a fantastic find. I recently stopped by for a quick bite and was thoroughly impressed by the vibe, the food, and the overall experience.

​The Food & Drink
​I ordered a Cappuccino and a Paneer Tikka Wrap, and both were spot on:
​The Cappuccino: It was served with a perfect layer of froth and had that rich, bold aroma you only get from high-quality beans. It wasn't overly bitter, making it the perfect companion for a breezy evening.

​The Tikka Wrap: This was the highlight! The wrap was generously stuffed with succulent, well-marinated paneer tikka, crunchy veggies, and just the right amount of sauce. It came served with a side of crispy golden French fries and a refreshing green chutney that added a great local zing. The portion size was very satisfying.

​Ambiance & Service
​The open-air seating is what really sets this place apart. It’s rare to find a spot that feels this airy and relaxed right near the hustle of the city. Whether you’re catching up with a friend or just want to get some work done with a view of the street, the atmosphere is very welcoming.
​The cafe operates on a self-service basis, which keeps the vibe casual and efficient—you order at the counter, and the staff is quick and polite. The menu is also surprisingly diverse, ranging from unique snacks like Corn Ribs to a wide variety of waffles and desserts.

​Final Verdict
​Kafe 9 is a 5-star experience for anyone who appreciates good coffee and honest, tasty food. It’s clean, the atmosphere is great, and the open sitting makes it a breath of fresh air in the neighborhood.
​I’ll definitely be coming back to try their "Sweet Aftermath" desserts next time!

I politely requested if I could do the plunge myself, but the staff member in charge refused. Even after I explained that I was genuinely interested in the process, I was not given a clear reason for the denial. What made the experience even more frustrating was the service speed. Despite ordering a French Press, I had to wait over 30 minutes to receive my coffee. For a beverage that was prepared on-site, the wait felt excessive, especially given the lack of communication or updates from the staff.
